sourceSentences: Upon dismounting, Kled lunges in the direction of the allied Nexus, though not through terrain, while cleansing himself of all crowd control and becoming unable to act, untargetable, and immune to crowd control for 0.5 seconds.
If Kled would be executed while Mounted, he is instead only Dismounted.
The bear trap collides with the first enemy champion, large pet, or large monster hit, revealing them for 2.5 seconds, and forming a tether between Kled and the target for 1.75 seconds.
The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, Kled pulls the target 150 units toward him, deals physical damage and slows them for 2.5 seconds.
Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while Jousting.
The tether cannot be broken within the first 0.25 seconds of its application.
While incurring its cooldown, Violent Tendencies' current cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds on-hit, increased to 1.5 against champions.
Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, dashes a fixed 350 units through them, marking them for 3 seconds, during which they are revealed.
Recast: consumes the mark to dash through the marked target, applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain.
Attempting to recast Jousting while outside of maximum range will make Kled path 550 units in the direction of the mark and consume the mark without casting the ability.

Kled & Skaarl charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are ghosted, immune to crowd control and revealed to enemy champions in a 1250 radius.
For combos, start E into Q and attack four times with your empowered W attacks. Reactivate E and then attack away. And this combo also works very well if you start with alt.
While dismounting, Kled cleanses himself of all crowd control effects and becomes briefly unargetable.
En sachant que tu ne peux pas traverser avec le E1. Mais par contre, si la personne a traversé mais que tu avais touché ton premier E, tu peux le suivre et traverser le mur.
E qui suit justement les personnes qui ont qui peuvent travers les murs, le spel qui touche un invisible.
